info.title: MapX SaaS API
info.description: Public REST API for MapX. Authenticate with a personal API key (Bearer mkx_...) created from the MapX account. All endpoints are scoped to the account that owns the key; each endpoint also enforces a capability scope (session, chat, files, layers, map, reports, remote, keys). Errors use a uniform envelope: {"error":{"code","message","details"}}. Rate limit: 300 requests per minute per key. The API resource is named `session` for historical reasons; it represents a persistent project in the product (a workspace with map state, layers, files, chat history, and reports).

patch.description: Partial update with merge semantics (PATCH): only fields present in the request body are applied; omitted fields retain their current values. mapState is merged into the existing map state (shallow merge), so a partial mapState (e.g. only basemap) preserves the other viewport fields; nested objects such as basemap or masks are replaced as a whole when provided. An empty object {} is a no-op and returns the current project. Requires scope: session.

post.description: Requires scope: files. Multipart upload. Supported extensions: .csv, .geojson, .json, .xlsx, .xls, .txt, .md, .docx, .doc, .pdf, .tif, .tiff. GeoJSON/JSON are added as layers directly; CSV/Excel are converted to GeoJSON layers; TIFF is converted to a COG image layer; text/document files are stored as plain files. Max size: 50MB (configurable via UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE_MB).

post.description: Requires scope: map. Applies a list of map actions to the live project, in order. Supported action types: fly_to, jump_to, fit_bounds, go_home, zoom_in, zoom_out, pan, zoom_to_layer, add_geojson_layer, add_tile_layer, add_cog_layer, remove_layer, rename_layer, set_layer_visibility, move_layer_up, move_layer_down, update_layer_style, set_basemap_style, set_basemap_category, set_country_mask, set_custom_mask, clear_layers. add_tile_layer without a layer_id is persisted by the backend (deduplicated by URL) and the created layer is returned in the response. Each action's parameters are described in the actions schema below.

actions.description: Map actions to apply in order. Each item must have a type; see the oneOf variants for supported types and parameters.

oneOf.title: fly_to
oneOf.description: Fly to a map center.

oneOf.title: jump_to
oneOf.description: Jump to a map center without animation.

oneOf.title: fit_bounds
oneOf.description: Fit the map viewport to a bounding box.

oneOf.title: go_home
oneOf.description: Reset the map to the default world view.

oneOf.title: zoom_in
oneOf.description: Zoom in one level.

oneOf.title: zoom_out
oneOf.description: Zoom out one level.

oneOf.title: pan
oneOf.description: Pan the map in a direction.

oneOf.title: zoom_to_layer
oneOf.description: Zoom to a layer's extent.
